subject: FIELD REPORT: multiple tube man thermal shutdowns, Midwest region
body: Service tech report, consolidated: 214 units down across OH/MI/IN dealerships. Pattern: blower motor thermal cutoff trips after 3 to 4 hours of continuous wave. Units restart after cooling, then trip again. Mostly Deluxe Flailing units installed in the last 18 months. Techs report motor housings hot to the touch. Requesting engineering review before we burn out more motors. Attached unit IDs available in fleet system.
